name: desktop-environment
description: Icon set for Desktop Environment (GNOME vs KDE vs XFCE vs i3) Animation — DE identity marks, hardware metric glyphs, generic app icons for dock/taskbar mockups, and moment accents (insight/tension) replacing emoji. Style: minimalist grayscale/monochrome flat icons, TRANSPARENT background so icons blend into the app's dark canvas and colored badges can be layered underneath in JSX.

style_guide.palette: grayscale monochrome (black/white/gray only) — icons stay neutral gray; per-DE color (blue GNOME / green KDE / yellow XFCE / red i3) is applied via badge/chip background in JSX, NOT baked into the PNG, so one icon file (e.g. app-browser) can be reused across all 3 DE mockups without recoloring
style_guide.notes: gnome-logo / kde-logo / xfce-logo should follow each brand's real official mark as closely as possible (GNOME footprint, KDE Plasma 'K' gear, XFCE mouse), redrawn in monochrome only — same treatment as Ubuntu/Fedora/etc in linux-vs-unix/icons.json. i3-grid is NOT a brand logo (i3 has no widely-recognized official mark) — keep it as a pure abstract asymmetric 2x2 split grid representing the tiling window manager concept.

batches.prompt:
Generate a 2x4 grid of 8 minimalist grayscale monochrome icons on TRANSPARENT background (PNG). Icons numbered top-left to bottom-right:

1. Official GNOME desktop environment footprint logo silhouette, redrawn in monochrome (real GNOME brand shape)
2. Official KDE Plasma gear-shaped 'K' logo silhouette, redrawn in monochrome (real KDE brand shape)
3. Official XFCE desktop environment mouse logo silhouette, redrawn in monochrome (real XFCE brand shape)
4. Abstract asymmetric grid icon: a square split into 4 unequal tiled panels (representing a tiling window manager, NOT a brand logo, purely geometric)
5. Simple RAM memory stick / module silhouette, minimalist flat icon
6. Square CPU processor chip icon with small pins along the edges
7. Small rotary control knob/dial with a pointer notch (like a volume or gauge dial)
8. [EMPTY - leave this slot blank/transparent]

Style requirements:
- Flat design, minimalist line-art
- Black/gray colors only (grayscale/monochrome), TRANSPARENT background (no solid fill behind icons)
- Each icon same size, clearly distinct, high contrast
- Grid layout: 2 rows x 4 columns
- Items 1-3 must match each real brand's official logo shape as closely as possible, only recolored to monochrome — do not invent a different shape

next_steps: 1. Run `docker compose up -d` so the unified app/API server is live at http://localhost:3373.
2. Load the Chrome extension `src/extensions/vm-icon-generator`, open a tab at https://chatgpt.com.
3. Click the extension icon, pick topic 'desktop-environment', run batch-1 then batch-2 (or 'All Batches (Sequential)' if supported).
4. Verify 14 cropped PNG files land in src/content/desktop-environment/icons/, filenames matching each icon 'id' (e.g. gnome-logo.png, app-browser.png).
5. Tell Claude when done — loader.js will be created and Animation.jsx will be wired to replace the manual SVG dock circles / emoji with these icons, with safe fallbacks for anything still missing.
